serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Yes, I’m here.
Big Daddy: Hello, little one! What brought you today?
You: I met some cashier in a store nearby. I think she might be a bot.
Big Daddy: Oh really? Now that’s very interesting. For what purpose someone would make a bot into a cashier? 
You: No idea.
Big Daddy: Do you have a picture of that bot?
You: No…
Big Daddy: That’s truly unfortunate! If I knew how it looks, maybe I could give you some information about it. After all, I’m something of an expert in these matters.
You: Sorry, if I knew a photo was needed I would take it…
You: If you want, I can try going there right now and see if she’s working.
Big Daddy: Hmmm…{{wi}} Let’s wait just a second.
Big Daddy: Her employer should have her pictures that were attached to CV. It’s common for sensitive information like that to leak to the bad parts of the net. 
Big Daddy: Take a seat and I will try finding more about that cashier of yours.
